section_rule: Rules on Benefit Sharing (Form I, Regulation 3-4)
title: Calculation of Access and Benefit Sharing (ABS) Percentages
content:
The official ABS regulations lay down the monetary benefit-sharing formula for commercial utilization of biological resources:
1. Annual Gross Ex-Factory Sale Percentage:
   - Up to INR 1 Crore: 0.1%
   - INR 1 Crore to 3 Crores: 0.2%
   - Above INR 3 Crores: 0.5%
2. IPR Commercialization Royalty: When an applicant obtains an IPR (patent) based on biological resources and commercializes it:
   - If the applicant licenses the IPR to a third party: 3.0% to 5.0% of the royalty received.
   - If the applicant commercializes it themselves: 0.2% to 1.0% of gross ex-factory sale.
3. Benefit Sharing proceeds are deposited in the National Biodiversity Fund and shared with local Biodiversity Management Committees (BMCs).
